Equation (10) defines the base-policy f-divergence set; equation (12) is the Jensen-relaxed observed-weight constraint; equation (14) is the conditional-moment relaxation of proper-policy constraints.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Tan describes sensitivity restrictions through density or odds ratios for treatment assignment conditional on potential outcomes, the standard source for the marginal odds-ratio sensitivity formulation.
The paper develops sharp nonparametric treatment-effect bounds through latent response-function representations and finite optimization.
Monotone treatment response is maintained as an assumption on individual response functions.
The manuscript studies perturbed linear SOCPs and establishes Lipschitz continuity and Hadamard directional differentiability of the optimal-value function under its regularity conditions.
The paper gives inference and an alternative resampling scheme for directionally differentiable maps when ordinary bootstrap consistency fails.
The paper develops uniform inference for optimal value functions using directional differentiability and bootstrap derivative estimation.
